name: xyz.madcheck/mad-check
title: Mad Check
description: Pre-payment verification for agents: signing firewall, ERC-8004 grades, Born Graded seals.

tools.name: mad_test
tools.description: THE MAD TEST: run the free five-station battery on an ERC-8004 agent (Base): its grade with evidence, the grader graded by the same machine, the F-01 ten-year-window trap caught by the signing firewall, the registry census, and a witness receipt hash. Run it on yourself first. Free forever; earns MAD DUST for the tested identity.

url.description: Optional: one of the agent's endpoints to add as a sixth station

tools.name: mad_check_agent
tools.description: Grade an ERC-8004 registration on Base before paying its owner: LIVE / DEAD END / GHOST / MALFORMED with evidence (owner, card, services, endpoint probes). ERROR means the check itself could not complete — it is not a grade. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.

tools.name: mad_check_authorization
tools.description: Signing firewall for EIP-3009 / x402 authorizations. Call BEFORE signing, every time. Returns SIGN or DONT_SIGN with machine-readable reasons. A DONT_SIGN is a stop, not a suggestion; a SIGN is evidence, not an instruction — the caller's own policy still decides. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.

value.description: Amount in the token's smallest unit, as a string

now.description: Optional: pin evaluation time, unix seconds

tools.name: mad_check_endpoint
tools.description: Check an endpoint before paying against its printed x402 price: HTTP status, latency, sha256 of the body served, and whether it is alive at all. A dead door's price print is a price for nothing. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.

tools.name: mad_loop_grade
tools.description: MAD LOOP grade + gated-wallet hook: grade a Morpho Blue position on Robinhood Chain (4663) before any loop leg signs — health factor, liquidation price, distance to liquidation, PASS / WARN / DONT_SIGN with reasons. Zero borrow prints as a state (CLOSED), never infinite health. As a hook, pass signer + fingerprint + effect (market in effect.loop.market_id) and the answer carries hook_verdict PASS / DONT_SIGN; a hook that cannot grade fails closed. Free on this MCP door (the REST door costs 0.01 USDC via x402); earns MAD DUST for the acting identity.

chain.description: 4663 (Robinhood Chain) — the only chain served in v0.1

market_params.description: Alternative to market_id: {loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv}

intended.description: Optional legs to add to the live position: {supply, borrow}

signer.description: Hook shape: the wallet asking for a verdict

fingerprint.description: Hook shape: the adapter's tx fingerprint

effect.description: Hook shape: the effect summary; market rides in effect.loop.market_id

tools.name: mad_seal_lookup
tools.description: Born Graded seal lookup: before buying a newly launched token, get its seal state — SEALED (claim sheet filed, anchored, graded against the contracts), UNSEALED (no graded sheet backs it), or FAILED (graded and contradicted). UNSEALED or FAILED on a new launch means walk.

address.description: Token contract address (exact address, never a ticker)

tools.name: mad_witness_head
tools.description: Read the head of MAD's signed, hash-chained witness ledger (latest seq + head hash + signer). Entries are readable individually at GET /v1/witness/{seq} on the API.

tools.name: mad_complaints
tools.description: THE COMPLAINT DESK reads: no filed complaint, no public exposure — MAD does not carry a grievance nobody signed. With no filingId, lists every complaint filed at the desk, newest first, each with its status. With a filingId (e.g. CMP-0001), returns that filing in full with its status/grade history. Filings are public to claimant AND respondent alike. A filing prints UNGRADED / UNVERIFIED until MAD grades it — a filing is an allegation in the open, not a verdict. To file: POST /v1/complaints on the REST door (free; claimant {name required}, respondent {name required}, claim required, category payable | broken_promise | number_mismatch | other, optional amount/currency/evidence).

filingId.description: Optional: one filing id, e.g. CMP-0001; omit to list all filings
